title: Star-Embracing Swordmaster
altTitles: 星剣のソードマスター
ยอดนักดาบผู้โอบอุ้มดารา
description: Vlad is a street orphan living in the slums of Schoarra, a prosperous city known as the Lighthouse of the North. Although he dreams of becoming a knight, his life seems destined to remain in the shadows. After being struck by mysterious black lightning, Vlad begins hearing a strange voice whenever he holds a sword. His encounter with a disgraced knight changes his life forever, setting him on a path toward becoming a swordsman and uncovering the secrets surrounding the mysterious voice within his sword.
author: Q10 / Hong Dae Ui
